eku_timestamping: C2PA 2.5 §13.5.1.1: a certificate valid for id-kp-timeStamping shall be valid for exactly that purpose; using it to sign a claim is an unauthorized purpose
eku_timestamping_claimsigning_policy: C2PA 2.5 §14: the signing certificate shall carry an EKU the validator associates with its trust anchors; under a claimSigning-only policy a timeStamping-only certificate has none
tst_wrong_imprint: C2PA 2.5 time-stamp validation: a message imprint that does not match gives timeStamp.mismatch (informational) and the time stamp is ignored; the leaf is then checked at the current time
tsa_no_timestamping_eku: C2PA 2.5: an invalid TSA credential gives timeStamp.untrusted (and optionally timeStamp.credentialInvalid), both informational, and the time stamp is ignored; the claim signer itself is unaffected
tsa_anchor_absent: C2PA 2.5: a TSA chain that does not reach a TSA trust anchor gives timeStamp.untrusted (informational) and the time stamp is ignored
ocsp_good: as ocsp_revoked: the CA-signed response is not usable; the manifest is trusted without revocation evidence
ocsp_revoked: C2PA 2.5 §13.5.1.1: a certificate that signs OCSP responses shall be valid for id-kp-OCSPSigning; a response signed by the issuing CA (no such EKU) is not usable and is treated as absent, so revocation is not learned from it
pqtsa_wrong_imprint: C2PA 2.5 time-stamp validation: a message imprint that does not match gives timeStamp.mismatch (informational) and the time stamp is ignored; the leaf is then checked at the current time
pqtsa_no_timestamping_eku: C2PA 2.5: an invalid TSA credential gives timeStamp.untrusted (and optionally timeStamp.credentialInvalid), both informational, and the time stamp is ignored; the claim signer itself is unaffected
pqtsa_anchor_absent: C2PA 2.5: a TSA chain that does not reach a TSA trust anchor gives timeStamp.untrusted (informational) and the time stamp is ignored
expired_leaf_wrong_imprint_tst: C2PA 2.5 §14.8.2: a time stamp the validator ignores cannot establish signing time; the signer's certificate is then evaluated at the current time, when it has expired
expired_leaf_untrusted_tst: as expired_leaf_wrong_imprint_tst: an untrusted time stamp is ignored, so the expired certificate is evaluated at the current time
expired_leaf_noeku_tst: as expired_leaf_wrong_imprint_tst: a time stamp from a TSA without id-kp-timeStamping is ignored
